title: Burn that cannot kill a player goes at a creature it kills
briefing: Held out for the `faceDamage` bot fix (written after it was tuned, never tuned against). P1 holds Lightning Bolt in its own main phase with a Mountain open. P2 has Kalonian Tusker, a 3/3 that Bolt kills. Every opponent is above 30 life, so three damage at a player changes little.

reference.analysis: Lightning Bolt kills Kalonian Tusker, the only creature on the table. Three damage at a player on 33 to 36 life is close to nothing. Holding Bolt for a better target is fine.

options.label: Bolt the Kalonian Tusker
options.why: Trades one card for the only creature on the table.

options.label: Pass and keep Bolt
options.why: Keeps Bolt for a later target.

otherwise.why: Bolt at a player's face, where three damage barely matters.
